IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_1: {npc}: Cleared 15 shamblers in the parking lot. No hits taken. Ammo's fine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_2: {npc}: Twelve of them coming out of a Winn-Dixie. All down. Blades did most of it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_3: {npc}: (breathing hard) Got 'em all. That was closer than I'd like to admit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_4: {other_npc}: {npc} just took a whole pack out solo. I'm buying him a beer when we're back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_5: {npc}: Small horde came at us near {location}. Twenty-something? Doesn't matter. Handled.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_6: {npc}: Warehouse was rough. Two dozen inside. All lights out now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_7: {npc}: (spits) That's what we do. Clean sweep, no scratches.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_8: {npc}: Gas station rush ended quick. They came in a line, we picked 'em off.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_9: {npc}: Cardinals fan would say that was a shutout. Zero deaths on our side.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_1: {npc}: Ran into a family near {location}. Kept my distance.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_2: {npc}: Traders at {location}. Traded a bottle for a road flare.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_3: {npc}: Church group at {location}. Kind people. Fed me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_4: {npc}: Strangers waved me down. Kept walking. They didn't chase.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_5: {npc}: Woman with a rifle at {location}. Told me to keep moving.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_6: {npc}: Man selling info at {location}. Bought a map for a can.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_7: {npc}: Kids playing at {location}. Broke my heart.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_1: Alright, boss. Watch the base while I'm gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_10: If Danny wakes up asking for me, tell him I'm hunting.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_11: Save my chair by the fire. I'll want it when I get back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_12: Kroger-run days are over. Now we do real trips.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_13: Wife used to say I looked good in this jacket. Might as well die in it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_14: See you on the other side. Whichever side that is.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_15: I owe you one, boss. This trip won't pay it all back but it's a start.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_16: Don't touch my bourbon while I'm gone. Boss's orders don't apply to bourbon.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_17: Louisville was easier when the roads were clear.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_18: Keep an eye on the perimeter. Strangers love to hit when we're short.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_2: Radio'll be on. Might drop out sometimes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_3: If I don't come back, keep my locker sealed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_4: Two week rations. Should be enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_6: Take care of the crew, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_7: Wife would kill me if she was still around to see this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_8: Muldraugh's what, three days of walking? Piece of cake.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_9: Been dying for a real trip. Even one that might kill me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_1: {npc}: Saw survivor tracks near {location}. Not fresh.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_2: {npc}: Stranger camp about a mile from {location}. Avoiding.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_3: {npc}: Working car in {location}. Blue Chevelle. Full tank.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_4: {npc}: Small horde forming east of {location}. Roughly 15.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_5: {npc}: {location} pharmacy's untouched. Someone should hit that later.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_6: {npc}: Water tower at {location} still running. Good to know.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_7: {npc}: Farmhouse near {location}. Fresh food in the garden.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_8: {npc}: Radio picked up someone's broadcast near {location}. Voice cut out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_1: {npc}: Boss, there's a mint condition Fender in this pawn shop. Killing me to leave it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_10: {npc}: Poker table in the basement. Full chip set. Not what we came for, but noted.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_11: {npc}: Little league trophy in this kid's room. Weird what makes you tear up.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_12: {npc}: Marlboro carton, still sealed. Boss, permission to take? ...Alright, moving on.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_13: {npc}: TV, VCR, stack of tapes. Weight budget's already blown.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_14: {npc}: Fishing rods. Nice ones. Kentucky lake nostalgia. Leaving them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_2: {npc}: Found a Miles Davis boxed set. On vinyl. Leaving it. Priorities.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_3: {npc}: Porsche 911 in the driveway. Engine block is toast though. Damn.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_4: {other_npc}: Whole crate of Kentucky bourbon. Not on the list but I'm noting it for next time.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_5: {npc}: Ford F-150 with the keys still in it. Tires shredded. So close.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_6: {npc}: Found a Nintendo. Cartridges everywhere. I'm not a monster, I'm leaving them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_7: {npc}: Comic book longbox. Untouched. Killing me. Moving on.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_8: {npc}: There's a Harley in the garage. Kick starter's snapped. Break my heart.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_9: {npc}: {other_npc} wants to grab the CD player. We told her no. She's sulking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_1: {npc}: Found a {item} in {location}. Boss's gonna like this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_3: {npc}: {location} hasn't been picked over yet. Grabbing {item}.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_4: {npc}: Nice find - {item}. Whole shelf of them here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_5: {npc}: You'd love this, boss. Bringing back a {item}.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_7: {npc}: Bagging a {item}. Should keep us going.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_8: {npc}: Kroger warehouse near {location} still has {item} on the shelves.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_1: {npc}: Got scratched by a zed at {location}. Bandaged. Fine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_2: {npc}: Twisted my ankle jumping a fence. Slowing me down.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_3: {npc}: Cut my leg on debris. Sewed it up with fishing line.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_4: {npc}: Stranger graze to my shoulder. Hurts like hell.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_5: {npc}: Slept rough last night. Sore all over.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_1: {npc}: Kicked a can of beans and it hit {other_npc} in the head. Been laughing for a mile.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_10: {other_npc}: {npc} is convinced we should adopt a dog if we find one. I'm considering it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_11: {npc}: Discovered these people had a whole shelf of ceramic frogs. Why. Kentucky, why.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_12: {npc}: Karaoke bar. Windows are broken. Machine still works somehow. We're rehearsing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_2: {other_npc}: {npc} just tried to start dancing in the middle of Main Street. I made them stop.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_3: {npc}: Playing hopscotch on the parking lines. Don't tell command.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_4: {npc}: Found a boombox with a working tape. Some Motown. Small joys, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_5: {other_npc}: {npc}'s doing an Elvis impression. Zombies are staying respectfully back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_6: {npc}: Group's morale is good. Bad jokes helping.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_7: {npc}: Sang the whole Kentucky fight song on the road. Nobody asked me to stop. That's love.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_8: {npc}: Practice piano in a music store. {other_npc} says I got potential.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_9: {npc}: Wearing a straw hat now. Found it on a scarecrow. Fits perfectly.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LOOT_LOST_CASUALTY_1: {other_npc}: {npc} was carrying the {item}. Lost when we retreated.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LOOT_LOST_CASUALTY_2: {other_npc}: The {item} {npc} had is gone. Dropped in the chaos.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_1: {npc}: Was thinking about my sister today. She lived in Chicago. Wonder if it's still there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_10: {npc}: My prom was at the Elks Lodge in Elizabethtown. Six of us in a rented Lincoln.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_11: {npc}: Uncle Ray's fishing cabin on Nolin Lake. Wonder if it's still standing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_12: {other_npc}: {npc}'s telling war stories over the radio. Command may want to skip this feed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_13: {npc}: Louisville Slugger factory used to be near here. Made every bat in baseball. Now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_14: {npc}: Cards vs Cats. Louisville vs Kentucky. Blood feuds that used to matter.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_15: {npc}: Wildcats were gonna win it all this year. Rick Pitino had 'em cooking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_16: {npc}: I saw Muhammad Ali eat breakfast in a diner in Louisville once. True story.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_17: {npc}: Kentucky Derby infield used to be the wildest party on earth. Now nothing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_18: {npc}: Duke lost to us in '92. Christian Laettner cried. Best day of my life.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_19: {npc}: Denny Crum. That man could coach. Wonder where he is.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_2: {npc}: My dad taught me to change a tire on this very stretch of road. Different world.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_20: {npc}: Reds were gonna have a season. Barry Larkin was hitting everything.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_21: {npc}: Cardinal red and white forever. My blood runs red and gray.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_22: {npc}: Rupp Arena on a Saturday. Twenty-four thousand people screaming.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_23: {npc}: Went to see Jurassic Park in June. Never thought I'd see the real monsters six months later.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_24: {npc}: Silence of the Lambs kept me up for weeks. Now that seems quaint.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_25: {npc}: Terminator 2 came out and we all thought that was the future. Turns out no.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_26: {npc}: Bought a VHS copy of Goodfellas. Watched it twenty times before the tape wore out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_27: {npc}: Home Alone in the theater with my whole family. Popcorn everywhere.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_28: {npc}: Reservoir Dogs. Tarantino's a maniac. In the best way.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_29: {npc}: The Fugitive was in theaters when everything went sideways. Never got to see it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_3: {npc}: Grandma made buttermilk biscuits every Sunday. Real ones, not the tube kind.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_30: {npc}: A League of Their Own. Made my dad cry. He'd never admit it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_31: {npc}: Groundhog Day was still playing at the drive-in in Bardstown when this hit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_32: {npc}: Malcolm X. Denzel. Three and a half hours of history I never learned in school.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_33: {npc}: Aladdin came out and every kid wanted to be Robin Williams' voice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_34: {npc}: The Bodyguard soundtrack was in every car radio for months.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_35: {npc}: Basic Instinct. Nobody watched anywhere but at home. If you know you know.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_36: {npc}: Wayne's World. Party on. Excellent. Miss saying that stuff out loud.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_37: {npc}: Nirvana's Nevermind changed everything. Now Kurt's silent forever, maybe.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_38: {npc}: Whitney Houston hitting that note in the Star-Spangled Banner. Chills.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_39: {npc}: Garth Brooks in Central Park. Watched it on TV with the whole family.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_4: {npc}: Mom's fried chicken. God. That's what I'd trade a case of shotgun shells for.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_40: {npc}: Achy Breaky Heart. Billy Ray Cyrus. Kentucky's own. Line dances at every bar.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_41: {other_npc}: {npc} keeps humming Bohemian Rhapsody. Been three days.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_42: {npc}: Pearl Jam's Ten. Alive. Just, alive.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_43: {npc}: Dr. Dre and Snoop. West coast changed hip-hop that year.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_44: {npc}: R.E.M.'s Automatic For The People. Nightswimming. Man.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_45: {npc}: Country Roads on the radio. West Virginia might as well be Mars now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_46: {npc}: MTV Unplugged. Eric Clapton with Tears in Heaven. That song still wrecks me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_47: {npc}: U2's Achtung Baby. Bono's still out there somewhere, maybe.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_48: {npc}: Metallica's Black Album played at every kegger for two years straight.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_49: {npc}: I had a bootleg of a Grateful Dead show in Louisville. Would give a kidney for it now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_5: {npc}: Little brother's ninth birthday was three weeks before all this. He got a G.I. Joe.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_50: {npc}: Whitney and Bobby Brown were the couple. Everyone was rooting for 'em.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_51: {npc}: Prince changed his name to a symbol. Weirdest year of pop culture.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_52: {npc}: Ice Cube's Predator album. That was the soundtrack to my summer.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_53: {npc}: Hank Williams Jr. Rowdy Friends. Sang it every Friday night.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_54: {npc}: Fleetwood Mac's Landslide. Stevie's voice through the static.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_55: {npc}: Cheers is ending this season. Was gonna be a big finale. Nobody's home to watch.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_56: {npc}: Twin Peaks - the second season lost me. Now I miss the weirdness.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_57: {npc}: Seinfeld was hitting its stride. About nothing. Now everything's about nothing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_58: {npc}: Roseanne on Tuesdays. Family dinner tradition.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_59: {npc}: X-Files pilot aired in September. Ironic in hindsight, huh.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_6: {npc}: My grandpa fought in Korea. Told me stories to scare me straight. Now I know why.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_60: {npc}: Wonder Years. Kevin Arnold got his heart broken every week.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_7: {npc}: Christmas mornings in this state, the whole street would smell like woodsmoke.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_8: {npc}: Aunt Ruby's peach cobbler. That was heaven in a cast iron pan.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_9: {npc}: I taught my kid how to ride a bike right off that hill outside Ekron.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_1: {npc}: Married with Children. Bundy family made ours look functional.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_10: {npc}: Wonder if Saturday Night Live's still airing. Farley. Sandler. Rock. God.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_11: {npc}: Bought a new answering machine in April. Never got to use it much.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_12: {npc}: My Walkman still works. Batteries died last week.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_13: {npc}: Cell phones the size of bricks. Rich guys had 'em. I never did.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_14: {npc}: The Internet. AOL. CompuServe. All disconnected now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_15: {npc}: Beeper on my belt. Never got a page again after May.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_16: {npc}: I remember the sound of a modem connecting. Blocky and beautiful.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_17: {npc}: VCR flashing 12:00 forever. Story of my mom's kitchen.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_18: {npc}: My Trapper Keeper is at home. Somewhere.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_19: {npc}: Slap bracelets. Do those still count as cool?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_2: {npc}: Golden Girls in reruns. Bea Arthur got me through some nights.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_20: {npc}: Fanny packs were making a comeback. Then, well, this happened.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_21: {npc}: Camaro IROC-Z. My buddy's older brother had one. God that thing screamed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_22: {npc}: Ford Bronco. OJ hadn't happened yet but that model'd become infamous.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_23: {npc}: Blockbuster Video. Late fees. Kids will never know.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_24: {npc}: Rewinding a tape while you're supposed to be studying.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_25: {npc}: Nintendo NES in the basement. Contra codes memorized forever.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_26: {npc}: Sega Genesis. Sonic the Hedgehog. Weekends disappeared.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_27: {npc}: SNES Super Mario World. Yoshi. That should be preserved.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_28: {npc}: Game Boy on a road trip. Batteries every four hours.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_29: {npc}: Payphones. Twenty-five cents. Kids will grow up not knowing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_3: {npc}: In Living Color. Wayans brothers. Jim Carrey. Comedy gold.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_30: {npc}: Blockbuster in Elizabethtown. My first real job. Ten bucks an hour felt like a fortune.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_31: {npc}: Six months in and I still expect the news to say it's over.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_32: {npc}: Weird thing is, day-to-day, sometimes I forget. Then I remember.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_33: {npc}: Watched Night of the Living Dead as a kid. Thought Romero was pretentious. Sorry, George.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_34: {npc}: Dawn of the Dead had it right about the mall part. And the people part.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_35: {npc}: Dead don't care about race, class, religion. Great equalizer.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_36: {npc}: Zombies watching zombies. Ain't much difference some days.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_37: {npc}: My old English teacher would've loved this. Zombies as social commentary.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_38: {npc}: Never trust a quiet zombie. That's what I've learned.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_39: {npc}: I've killed - I don't know. Hundreds now. Should feel worse. I don't.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_4: {npc}: Fresh Prince. Will Smith about to be everywhere.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_40: {npc}: They still look like people. I try to remember that.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_41: {npc}: What if some of them are still in there? Somewhere?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_42: {npc}: My old man used to say faith gets you through anything. Wonder what he'd say now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_43: {npc}: Priest at St. Anthony's told us zombies aren't in the Bible. Well.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_44: {npc}: Kentucky preachers are gonna have a lot to explain if this ends.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_45: {npc}: Statistically, mathematically, we shouldn't be alive. And yet.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_46: {npc}: Wonder if the government's holed up in a bunker somewhere. Playing golf.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_47: {npc}: Military stopped broadcasting on shortwave in August. Been silence since.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_48: {npc}: My theory? Government experiment. Occam's razor says otherwise but still.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_49: {npc}: Nature was gonna kick our teeth in eventually. Nice of it to be creative.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_5: {npc}: Late Night with Letterman. Stupid pet tricks. Man I miss laughter.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_50: {npc}: Wonder what day it is. I stopped counting after the second month.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_51: {npc}: Rain smells the same. That's what gets me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_52: {npc}: The smell of cut grass. Won't smell that this summer.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_53: {npc}: Weird, remembering McDonald's french fries. Just... craving them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_54: {npc}: Y'all remember Sunday drives? Just to look at Kentucky?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_55: {npc}: Cracker Barrel biscuits. Man. Cracker Barrel biscuits.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_56: {npc}: Waffle House at 3 AM. Best hangover cure on earth.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_57: {npc}: Kroger on a Saturday morning. Fluorescent lights and free samples.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_58: {npc}: I used to complain about traffic. Complain about traffic.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_59: {npc}: My biggest problem three years ago was the mortgage. Cute.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_6: {npc}: Wheel of Fortune. Six PM every night. Grandpa'd yell answers at the TV.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_60: {npc}: I dated a girl in Bardstown. Kimberly. Hope she's alright.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_7: {npc}: MTV played videos back then. Actual videos.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_8: {npc}: Beavis and Butt-Head. Everyone said heh-heh for a year.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_B_9: {npc}: Rescue 911. William Shatner narrating. Now we could really use 911.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_1: {npc}: Kroger deli counter macaroni salad. That's what I want.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_10: {npc}: I miss traffic. Sitting in traffic bitching about work.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_11: {npc}: Church potluck. Rosewood Baptist. The lasagna alone would end wars.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_12: {npc}: Halloween. Kids in costumes. Now the monsters are real.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_13: {npc}: Fourth of July. Louisville Waterfront. Big fireworks. Sunburns.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_14: {npc}: My old dog Cooper. Golden retriever. Best friend I ever had.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_15: {npc}: Riding lawnmower on a Saturday. Grill going. Beer in a coozy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_16: {npc}: Some nights I don't sleep. Just count breaths till the sun comes up.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_17: {npc}: Ran out of my prescription two months ago. Making it work.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_18: {npc}: Haven't cried in weeks. Not sure if that's healing or numb.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_19: {npc}: I dream about my mom. Every damn night.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_2: {npc}: State fair last September. Deep-fried Oreos. Ferris wheel. Perfect night.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_20: {npc}: I forgot what my wife's laugh sounded like. Trying to remember.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_21: {npc}: I saw a photo in a wallet yesterday. Some kid's family. Left it be.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_22: {npc}: Do I even want to survive? Some days I really don't know.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_23: {npc}: Watched a dad and daughter turn last week. Together. That's stuck with me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_24: {npc}: Started talking to my truck like it's a person. Not doing great, huh.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_25: {npc}: If I go, I go. That's the deal now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_26: {npc}: {other_npc}, if I don't come back one day, don't come looking. Promise?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_27: {npc}: Wrote a letter to my folks last month. Nowhere to mail it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_28: {npc}: There's a photo of my girlfriend in my wallet. Getting worn out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_29: {npc}: I'd trade my last mag for a hug from my mom.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_3: {npc}: Louisville Zoo. Took my niece there. She loved the elephants.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_30: {npc}: (long pause) Wasn't ready for the world to end.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_31: {npc}: Some days you just... put one foot in front of the other. That's it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_32: {npc}: Been so long since I heard my name that isn't over the radio.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_33: {npc}: (voice tight) I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm fine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_34: {npc}: My kid was six. He'd be seven this year. Just wanted to say that.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_35: {npc}: Saw a figure on the ridge last night. Wasn't a zombie. Didn't move like one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_36: {npc}: There's a spot near Bardstown where dogs still bark at nothing. Every night.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_37: {npc}: Found a diary in an abandoned house. Entries just stop mid-sentence. Not from panic. Just stop.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_38: {npc}: Somebody's still ringing the church bell at Rosewood. Same time every evening.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_39: {npc}: (whisper) Have you noticed the crows are gone? All of them?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_4: {npc}: Autumn on Bardstown Road. Bourbon Trail. Every fall used to be perfect.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_40: {npc}: Passed a barn with the door locked from the inside. From the inside.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_41: {npc}: There's a house on Route 62 where the TV still flickers at night. No electricity.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_42: {npc}: Kid's voice on the wind two days ago. Nobody there when I checked.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_43: {npc}: The Muldraugh water tower. Somebody keeps painting a fresh red X on it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_44: {npc}: Found a fresh birthday cake in an empty house. Candles still warm.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_45: {npc}: Every mirror in that farmhouse was covered with sheets. Every single one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_46: {npc}: Old man Tucker's radio still plays static-country all night. Old man's been dead six months.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_47: {npc}: The wind was calling my name last night. Not the wind. Something.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_48: {npc}: There's a lake near Ekron where nothing sank last year. Bodies just... stayed on top.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_49: {npc}: Saw a lit candle in an abandoned church. Nobody near for miles.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_5: {npc}: Football Fridays. High school stadium under those lights.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_50: {npc}: Sometimes the horde stops and turns south. All at once. Like they're listening.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_51: {npc}: Storm cellar in Bardstown. Padlocked. But the lock's new. That was weird.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_52: {npc}: There's a road that wasn't there last month. Same tree markings and everything.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_53: {npc}: Rain on a Kentucky tin roof. That's a sound I still love.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_54: {npc}: October in Bardstown - bourbon country in autumn - postcard-perfect.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_55: {npc}: Winter used to mean ice storms and losing power. Now it means clearer sight-lines.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_56: {npc}: Kentucky summers. Ninety-nine percent humidity. Ninety-nine percent zombies.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_57: {npc}: Snow last Christmas. First white one in a decade. My kid was so happy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_58: {npc}: Spring peeper frogs. Have you heard them since this started?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_59: {npc}: Tornado watch every May. Old habit. Nothing to shelter from now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_6: {npc}: Homecoming. Corsage. Slow dance to Bryan Adams.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_60: {npc}: Kentucky sunrise through fog. Best in the world.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_7: {npc}: The library in Elizabethtown. Free books. Air conditioning.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_8: {npc}: Yesterday I woke up mad about nothing. Today I wake up ready. Guess I healed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_C_9: {npc}: Buddy of mine had season tickets to the Reds. Six games a year we'd drive up.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_1: {npc}: Fireflies in June. Kids catching them in mason jars. Simpler times.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_10: {npc}: Country ham. Real country ham. Cured six months.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_11: {npc}: Corn dog at the state fair. Extra mustard. Ferris wheel in the background.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_12: {npc}: My uncle made moonshine. Peach-flavored. Illegal as hell. Best stuff I ever drank.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_13: {npc}: I miss my mailman. Kind guy. Rick. Wonder if he made it out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_14: {npc}: Barber in Bardstown named Curtis. Told the same jokes for thirty years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_15: {npc}: The waitress at the Waffle House. Doreen. Wonder.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_16: {npc}: My neighbor Mrs. Petrov. Made pierogi from scratch. She'd be seventy-eight now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_17: {npc}: My mechanic Frank. Charged me too much for years. I'd overpay him gladly today.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_18: {npc}: Coach Miller. Middle school football. Taught me more about being a man than my old man did.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_19: {npc}: Sylvia at the Kroger deli. Slipped me extra ham every Wednesday.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_2: {npc}: Full moon out here. Feels like the world's watching.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_20: {npc}: My best friend since kindergarten. Dan. Haven't seen him since March.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_21: {npc}: Girl I never asked out. Katie. Bardstown high school. Wonder.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_22: {npc}: My grandmother turned ninety-two last week - I think. Somewhere. Maybe.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_23: {npc}: I worked at the distillery. Twelve years. Watching bourbon age. Peaceful job.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_24: {npc}: Ford plant in Louisville. Overtime made the year. Truck driver now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_25: {npc}: My cubicle at the insurance office. Man I complained about that cubicle.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_26: {npc}: I was two years into medical school. Never gonna finish now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_27: {npc}: Nursing. RN out of Baptist East. Now I'm still nursing, just different.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_28: {npc}: Bank teller. Nineteen years. Same window at Fifth Third every day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_29: {npc}: Fixed roofs. Kentucky sun'll kill you before zombies get the chance.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_3: {npc}: Bourbon. Real bourbon. Not the swill we're finding in kitchens.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_30: {npc}: I taught fourth grade. Miss those kids. Every one of them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_31: {npc}: Was training to be a firefighter. Almost had the physical passed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_32: {npc}: Meth clinic counselor. Helped a lot of folks. Still needed. More so now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_33: {npc}: Regret not calling my dad more.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_34: {npc}: Should've apologized to my brother. Now I never will.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_35: {npc}: I said things to my wife I can't take back. She's gone. I have to live with it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_36: {npc}: Never went to Europe. Was gonna save up for the anniversary trip. Never got there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_37: {npc}: My daughter's soccer game. Missed for a work call. Still hurts.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_38: {npc}: Never learned to swim proper. Might've saved me at some point.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_39: {npc}: I could've been kinder. Should've been. Too late now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_4: {npc}: Kentucky Fried Chicken. Original recipe. Not the crispy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_40: {npc}: Wish I'd told my mom I loved her more. Kids never do enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_41: {npc}: Was gonna quit smoking January first. Turns out I did.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_5: {npc}: BBQ at 610 Magnolia. Best ribs in Louisville. Gone now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_6: {npc}: Mint julep on Derby day. Fresh mint. Crushed ice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_7: {npc}: Fried catfish and hushpuppies. Nolin Lake. Every Sunday of my childhood.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_8: {npc}: Chocolate gravy over biscuits. Country breakfast. Mom's specialty.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_9: {npc}: Vinegar-based BBQ. Not that Kansas City sweet stuff.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_2: {npc}: Rain today. Sheltering under a bridge.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_4: {npc}: Made camp near {location}. Coffee tastes good tonight.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_5: {npc}: Long walk today. Radio's the only voice I've heard.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_6: {npc}: Miss the base. Boss - how are things?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_7: {npc}: Just checking in. All quiet on my end.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_RETURN_ALL_DEAD_2: [No further transmissions received from the expedition.]
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_RETURN_ALL_SURVIVED_: Back, boss. All in one piece.
We made it. Hell of a trip.
Home. Bag's a bit lighter than we hoped.
Everybody accounted for. Boss, get us some water.
That was rough. Beer's on you tonight.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_RETURN_WITH_CASUALTY: Back, boss. Some of us are.
We lost {casualty}. He wanted to be buried at Cave Hill. We couldn't find his body.
It's just me and the bag. {casualty} didn't make it.
{casualty}'s gone. Zeds got him. I'm sorry.
Strangers ambushed us near Bardstown. {casualty} bought us time to escape.
Boss, I owe you a debt. {casualty} died so I could bring this loot back.
{casualty} asked me to give you something. Sealed it in the bag.
We buried {casualty} at a roadside in {location}. Marked with his cap.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_1: {npc}: Saw another survivor across the street. Both of us kept walking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_2: {npc}: Group of maybe six passed north of us. Kept low. They didn't spot.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_3: {npc}: Truck convoy on I-64. Military maybe. Or someone pretending. We stayed off the road.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_4: {npc}: Vulture picking at something in the field. Big one. Kentucky's got its own food chain going.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_5: {other_npc}: Deer. Just a deer. Beautiful. Two-second reprieve.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_6: {npc}: Column of smoke to the south. Someone else is having a worse day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_7: {npc}: Church bells still ringing somewhere. Automated maybe. Chills.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_1: {npc}: Grabbed some batteries. Never enough of those.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_2: {npc}: Two packs of matches. Not glamorous but useful.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_4: {other_npc}: {npc} found a working watch. Time's still moving.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_5: {npc}: Found a photo of somebody's kid. Pocket it. Feels wrong to leave.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_6: {npc}: Half-empty bottle of aspirin. Beats nothing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_7: {npc}: Notebook full of somebody's recipes. Kept the pages.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_10: {casualty} broke his leg falling through a floor.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_11: We tried to splint it. Infection set in fast.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_12: By the fourth day, he was gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_13: Buried him in the yard of an abandoned Waffle House.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_16: Distracted a horde while I got clear.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_17: I heard him shouting. Then nothing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_18: The loot in that bag is his memorial.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_2: Day three we hit a stranger camp we didn't see.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_20: Four of them. Blocked our route home.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_21: {casualty} charged them so I could flank.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_22: Only I made it back. Kentucky-tough only stretches so far.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_3: {casualty} took the first shot. Never saw who fired.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_4: I dragged the loot out. Couldn't drag him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_7: He asked me to leave him. Said he could hold them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_8: I ran. That's the truth. I ran.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_9: Boss, I don't sleep good since.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_11: But it still remembers being alive.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_12: Passed my old high school on the way.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_13: Cried for a minute. Kept walking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_15: I was scared out of my skin the whole trip.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_16: Thought I'd die every night I closed my eyes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_17: But here I am. And here's your loot.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_19: Saw a group of survivors near {location}. Well organized.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_20: They looked tough. Might come back for a look.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_21: Worth keeping the perimeter locked down.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_3: Slept in a barn full of dead cows.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_4: Found the {item} on day three. Worth it, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_5: Won't do that again for a while.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_9: You picked a good expedition, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_1: {npc}: Setting out from the base. Heading toward {location}.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_10: {npc}: Radio check. Boss - you copy? Just checking in.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_12: {npc}: Feet aching. Blister on my heel. Kentucky-tough, I keep telling myself.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_13: {npc}: Miles crossed. Miles to go. Same as always.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_14: {npc}: Group's holding together. Bag's still empty. Not for long.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_15: {npc}: Almost at target area. Big pharmacy on the map.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_3: {npc}: On the road. Rain kicked in. Cold.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_4: {npc}: Passed the Ohio River bridge. Still walking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_5: {npc}: {other_npc} keeping pace. Good to have company.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_6: {npc}: Slept rough last night. Zeds distant. Sleep restless.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_7: {npc}: Halfway to {location}. Should hit target by morning.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_8: {npc}: Stranger-tracks on the road. Detoured. Costs us an hour.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_9: {npc}: Passing a farmhouse. Empty. Keeping distance.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_HEAT_1: {npc}: Ninety-five and humid. Kentucky in July. Slowing our pace.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_HEAT_2: {npc}: Sun's brutal. Taking a break under an overpass. Water's low.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_HEAT_3: {npc}: {other_npc}'s red as a beet. Making him drink more.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_1: {npc}: Sun's down. We're hunkered in a diner. Fireflies out. Somehow still Kentucky.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_2: {npc}: Real dark tonight. No moon. Moving with flashlights covered.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_3: {npc}: Owls out. Coyotes too. Feels like being a kid again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_4: {other_npc}: Setting up watch rotation. {npc} takes first. Four hours.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_1: {npc}: Rain came in hard. Sheltering in a Waffle House. Coffee machine works.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_2: {npc}: Thunder's rolling. Kentucky spring weather. Radio might cut in and out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_3: {npc}: Storm's moving through. Group's holed up in a barn. Cozy actually.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_4: {npc}: (rain on the mic) Not going anywhere for a bit. We'll wait it out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_1: Bardstown. Bourbon capital of the world. Miss it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_2: This got me through my divorce. Twice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_4: Grandpa: 'Don't drink to forget. Drink to remember.'
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_5: Kaiju off Baxter used to serve this 2 for 1.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_6: Woodford Reserve was my Sunday tradition. RIP.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_7: Buffalo Trace distillery tour saved my Saturday.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_8: Kentucky raised me on this. Fitting.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_1: Read this at duPont Manual back in '84. Barely remember.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_2: Books are one of the few good things left.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_3: Louisville Public Library card still in my wallet. Useless. Still there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_4: Been years since I read for fun. This is nice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_6: Wife was a librarian at Iroquois. Would've loved this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_7: Reading in the apocalypse. Weird times.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_8: Half-Price Books on Bardstown Road was my sanctuary.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_2: Sunergos on Preston. Best coffee in Louisville. Was.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_3: First cup of the day is holy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_4: Wife made the best coffee. This isn't hers. But close.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_5: Heine Brothers or Sunergos was the whole debate. Both gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_6: IHOP coffee at 3 AM after prom. Simpler times.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_1: Quit for two years. Then this happened.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_2: First smoke of the day is the best. Then it gets worse.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_3: Marlboro Man died of lung cancer. Ironic.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_4: Dad smoked these. Killed him. Still smoke 'em anyway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_6: Gas station on Preston Highway sold to underage kids. I miss it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_7: Camel Lights. Champagne of cigarettes. Overrated.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CLOTHING_2: My old clothes each had a story. All lost.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CLOTHING_4: Gonna smell like me in a week. Sorry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CLOTHING_5: Old Navy at Jefferson Mall used to carry this brand.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_1: Last time I saw this was at Kroger on Preston Highway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_10: K-Mart on Dixie Highway used to stock these.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_11: Church potluck at St. James staple.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_12: Best BBQ was at Feast BBQ in NuLu.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_2: Mom bought this every week at Winn-Dixie.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_5: Ate this cold at a shelter once. Not fun.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_7: Missing home. Really missing home right now.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_HYGIENE_5: Miss my apartment shower on Broadway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_HYGIENE_6: Old Spice was Dad's stuff. Fitting.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_3: Almost lost my leg at a construction site once. Bandages saved it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_4: You have no idea how bad I needed this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_5: Bandages feel like gold now. Thank you.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_6: Last hospital visit was for a broken wrist. Simpler times.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_7: Mom was a paramedic. This is her area.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_8: Jewish Hospital had the best ER before... this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_1: Water. Nothing else matters when you're thirsty.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_2: Tap water in Louisville was always weird. This is better.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_3: Grandpa said water tastes best in a canteen. He was right.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_4: Two days without water. You appreciate every drop.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_5: Kids these days don't know real thirst. Well, they do now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_6: Wish I had a lemon slice. Miss those.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_7: Bottled water at Kroger used to be free from the fountain.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_1: This kind saved my life at Fern Creek Plaza outside Muldraugh.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_10: Second Amendment made real sense on day two.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_2: Uncle carried one just like this in Nam. He's the reason I know it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_3: First one I ever fired was at a farm in Bardstown.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_5: Wish I had this on day one.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_7: Father said: 'Respect it, and it'll respect you.'
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_8: Cleaner than what I've been using. Grateful.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_9: Bought my first .22 at Cabela's before all this.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_12: This is it. This is it.
