IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day01_S: Is this thing on? I think I finally got it working
Marcus and Ray are asleep. So it's just us
Electrical tip: You need a screwdriver. For everything
It's the most important tool you'll find
Without one, you can't even take apart a radio
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day02_S: I was an engineering student. Third year
Ray found me three weeks ago. Brought me here
Carpentry tip: Always have an escape route. Second floor? Use a sheet rope
A nail, a sheet, and a hammer
Don't get trapped upstairs without one
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day03_S: Fixed the generator yesterday. Carbon on the spark plug
Marcus tried to help. He held the flashlight
Electrical tip: Never run a generator indoors
The fumes build up fast. You won't wake up
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day04_S: Found some old engineering books yesterday
Reminds me of pulling all-nighters in the library
Carpentry tip: Need wood but can't chop trees?
Interior doors are just free planks waiting to be claimed
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day05_S: Ray snores. Just putting that out there
Marcus pretends he doesn't hear it. I know he does
Electrical tip: Generators chew through fuel
If your fridge is empty, turn it off
Don't waste gas cooling empty air
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day06_S: Marcus tried to help with the antenna yesterday
He held the ladder. That was... helpful
Carpentry tip: Want that nice couch? Be careful moving it
It takes skill to not break furniture
Don't rush or you'll just have scrap wood
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day07_S: Ray showed me how to set a snare last week
I think he's warming up to me
Electrical tip: Save your electronic scrap
You'll need it to repair the generator eventually
It's not junk, it's spare parts
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day08_S: I've been boosting our signal range
Found copper wire in an old house. Hello, new listeners!
Carpentry tip: Organization saves lives. Build crates
Piles of loot on the floor will just slow you down
Label them if you have paint
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day09_S: Wonder if there are working universities out there
Electrical tip: Digital watches are everywhere
Don't ignore them. They're perfect for practicing
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day10_S: Marcus asked about my family yesterday
They were in Louisville when it started
Carpentry tip: Garbage bags aren't just for trash
You'll need them for rain collectors later
Save everyone you find. Trust me
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day11_S: Found a ham radio yesterday. Still works!
I'm fixing it up as a backup
Electrical tip: Ham radios have way better range
Walkie talkies are fine for a convoy, but useless for distance
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day12_S: But I think he means it affectionately
Carpentry tip: Fences are okay. Log walls are better
Four logs and some ripped sheets
It's heavy work, but nothing's getting through
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day13_S: They were... interesting. But he tried
Electrical tip: You can build noise makers with spare parts
A radio, some sensors... good for distractions
Lure them away from where you sleep
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day14_S: I keep thinking about trying to reach Louisville
Not that I've told Marcus or Ray
Carpentry tip: Dirt floors are depressing. And dirty
Use planks to lay proper wooden flooring
You can claim any building if you fix it up
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day15_S: I met some people yesterday! A group heading east
One of them knows about solar power
Electrical tip: Remote triggers are basically modified V1 controllers
Trigger a device from a safe distance
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day16_S: Talked to that group again. They're staying nearby
They're planning a route to Louisville
Mechanics tip: Protect your car's engine
If the hood is damaged, the engine takes the hits
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day17_S: The group has a car they're fixing up
I offered to help. Turns out I'm useful
Electrical tip: Timer switches aren't just for baking
Set a noise maker to go off in ten minutes
Be far away when it does
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day18_S: The group leader is named Sarah. She was a nurse
They've got a mechanic named Tom
Mechanics tip: It's getting colder. Check your car heater
You can sleep in a warm car if you have to
Beats freezing to death in a tent
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day19_S: Marcus and Ray don't know I've been meeting them
I don't know why I haven't told them
Electrical tip: Motion sensors from home alarms can be repurposed
If you know what you're doing, you can make a perimeter
A warning system that never sleeps
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day20_S: Replaced brake pads yesterday. My first time
Tom said I'm a quick learner. That felt good
Mechanics tip: Not all cars are equal
Vans and trucks carry way more gear
Sometimes speed doesn't matter as much as storage
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day21_S: I've been learning so much from Tom
Ray would probably approve. He's practical like that
Electrical tip: Generators degrade over time
If it starts smoking, fix it or it explodes
Electronic scrap is the only way to patch the boards
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day22_S: Sarah asked if I wanted to come with them
To Louisville. I said I'd think about it
Mechanics tip: Loud cars equal death
A damaged muffler draws them in from miles away
Install a good one or stay off the road
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day23_S: I already know my answer. I've always known
I'm just scared to admit it
Electrical tip: House lamps are a great source of bulbs and wire
Dismantle them if you need parts for bigger projects
Even a small desk lamp has what you need to fix a generator
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day24_S: I said yes. I'm going to Louisville
The group leaves in six days
Mechanics tip: Don't walk if you can drive
Don't drive one car if you can take two. Tie a second car to yours
Tow it back to base for parts
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day25_S: Five days left. The car is almost ready
I fixed the alternator myself. Tom supervised
Electrical tip: alternators charge your battery
Dead battery while running means bad alternator
Listen for whining sounds under the hood
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day26_S: I told Marcus. He joked about me outgrowing them
But his eyes were sad. Ray just nodded
Mechanics tip: Car dead? Might just be the battery
You can charge it with a battery charger
Don't scrap a good car over a flat battery
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day27_S: Three days left. I keep looking at them differently
Electrical tip: Streetlights are gone. But you can rig worklights
Power them with a generator for night defense
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day28_S: Two days left. The car's ready. I packed my stuff
I'm bringing the ham radio. For emergencies
Mechanics tip: Lost the key? You can hotwire it
You need electronics skill and mechanics skill
Cross the wires and drive away
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Day29_S: Last full day. Marcus gave me his lucky compass
Ray marked dangerous areas on his map for me
Electrical tip: always have a backup radio
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Signoff: This is Jenna, signing off. See you tomorrow!
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Welcome: Good morning! Jenna here with your Morning Show
Hey everyone! It's Jenna. Welcome to another broadcast
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Jenna_Wrapup_: Anyway, that's all I've got for today
Alright, I should probably go check on things
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Marcus_Day91_: Ray's gone. Yesterday. The attack came too fast
I buried him this morning. Before dawn
He's by the lake, near the big oak tree
If you knew him... you can find him there
We'll miss you, my good friend
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Marcus_Day92_: I've been sitting here for an hour
Ray made this look easy. Jenna too
This is the last morning show
I'll keep doing intel broadcasts. 1 PM, 7 PM
But this part was for us. Goodbye

IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day31_S6: I'll be giving you tips depending on what we learn with Marcus

IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day33_S2: Marcus made coffee this morning. Burnt it

IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day33_S6: You can see through them. Blocks long enough
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day34_S2: Marcus found a deck of cards
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day34_S3: He's actually pretty good at poker. Who knew?
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day34_S4: Carpentry tip: Need nails? Disassemble beds
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day34_S6: Good wood and nails. No chopping required
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day35_S2: Rain's coming down hard in here
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day35_S3: Roof's holding. I built it well
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day35_S5: Plumb them to a sink underneath
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day35_S6: Clean water without leaving the house
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day36_S2: Marcus told a joke today. A bad one
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day36_S3: I actually laughed. Must be the isolation
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day36_S6: They can't climb sheet ropes. You can
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day37_S3: She loved this time of year
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day37_S5: A plank and a knife. Simple
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day38_S2: Saw a deer near the fence line
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day38_S4: Carpentry tip: Build wall frames first
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day38_S6: Upgrade them to walls when you have the wood
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day39_S2: Marcus tried digging with a spoon. City kids
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day39_S3: So this week is a good time for tips on gardening
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day39_S4: Farming tip: Use the right tools
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day39_S6: Don't use your hands. You'll need them
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day40_S2: Found a packet of mystery seeds
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day40_S3: Hope it's not broccoli. Hate broccoli
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day40_S4: Farming tip: Don't plant them all at once
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day40_S6: Harvest a little every week. Keep it fresh
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day41_S2: Rained all night. Good for the barrel
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day41_S4: Farming tip: Check water levels daily
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day42_S3: Marcus blames bugs. I blame bad luck
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day42_S6: Cure it or cut it. Don't wait
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day43_S2: The smell of that compost bin. Whew
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day43_S3: Smells like life. Or death. Hard to tell
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day43_S4: Farming tip: Rotten food isn't trash
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day44_S2: Marcus is staring at the tomatoes
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day44_S3: Told him green ones give you a stomach ache
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day44_S4: Farming tip: Let some plants go to seed
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day44_S6: Seeds are your future. Keep them
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day45_S2: Our farm is starting to look good
IGUI_KnoxRelay_MorningShow_Ray_Day45_S4: Farming tip: Plant hardy crops in the fall

IGUI_Bandits_Speech_ZSStreetChat2_Male_4: It's the soldiers, they are making us sick.
I feel anxious, something's going to happen soon.
I think we chould prepare for something big.
I think other people feel that way too.
I know. I can feel it.
I also fell irritated all the time.
I must do something to relax.
And the cough, seems like it's not me only.
IGUI_Bandits_Speech_ZSStreetChatBlood_Fe: Why are you covered in blood?
Why are you covered in blood?
IGUI_Bandits_Speech_ZSStreetChatBlood_Ma: Why are you covered in blood?
You look like you are having a bad day!
You're all covered in blood! You need help?
IGUI_Bandits_Speech_ZSStreetChatFinal_Ma: The world is about to end!
Where is that light coming from?
That light! Is it what I think it is?
Our Father who art in heaven...
The world is about to end!
IGUI_Bandits_Speech_ZSStreetChatHealth_F: You look like you had a bad day!
That may be it for you...
That may be it for you...

IGUI_NotAlone_CommunityFull: My community is full. I can't take any more people.
IGUI_NotAlone_CompanionFull: I can't lead any more people right now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_GoToBase: Alright. Got it. I'll head over to the base.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_001: I used to love Romero movies... I can't enjoy them anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_003: Did you hear the screaming last night? No? Then never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_004: Dead, but not dead. Strange, isn't it?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_005: Must be the wind. The stench is awful today.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_006: Ever been to Texas? It was more dangerous than this place.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_007: You hear that? They say Osaka, Japan managed to quarantine itself.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_008: Chemicals, viruses, aliens... what do you think caused this?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_009: So this is The Last Man on Earth, huh?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_010: After a fight, that's when I get scared. You'll believe me if I say I wasn't bitten, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_011: If you get bitten, don't hide it. That's how communities fall apart.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_012: I dream about killing people I loved. I wish it had only been a dream.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_013: Believe it or not, they used to call me "Mad."
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_014: I'm done being a zombie movie fan. I'm switching to shark movies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_015: Don't wear headphones. You'll get bitten from behind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_016: If this pandemic ever ends... no, I won't say the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_017: Let's not start fighting each other, alright? That's the boring part of the story.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_018: I saw it. The day before this started, something came down from the sky... never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_020: Oh, it's you. Thought you were a zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_021: I once killed three zombies with one bullet. You don't believe me, do you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_022: I once killed three zombies with one swing. That one's a lie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_023: Don't get careless. If you do, I can't afford to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_024: Zombies don't have anywhere to go either. That's why they wander around.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_025: What do we call them? Zombies? Undead? Infected?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_026: There's a game I never finished. I want to go get it someday.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_027: Shoot. Swing. The world's gotten real simple.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_028: Should've prepared a mohawk and spiked shoulder pads.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_029: Rumor says the military's gathering in California. Rumor says.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_030: You think this is God's test?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_031: When there's no more room in Hell, huh?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_032: You only realize how good it is to have people around when you're alone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_033: This is the first time I've ever been grateful for gun culture.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_034: Thanks for letting me join you. Just... don't kick me out, alright?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_035: Do you count your shots? You should.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_036: Check your gear before we head out. You always forget something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_037: The world's gone to hell, but sometimes... sometimes it's still kind of fun.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_038: We smell almost as bad as they do.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_039: I want something sweet. Something spicy, too...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_042: We should burn the bodies. Sorry, Jesus, but we can't have them coming back.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_043: I'm worried about my cousin. Knowing him, he might be eating the zombies instead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_044: I'm looking for a friend I got separated from. I hope I don't find them in the horde.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_045: Cough! Cough! ...What? It's just a cough.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_046: I saw a zombie holding a sign that said \"Zombie Rights.\"
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_047: I once saw a drunk walking with a pack of zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_048: You're the leader. Keep it together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_049: I heard a zombie bit Chuck Norris, suffered for a while, then died.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_050: Their teeth can bite through clothes. Be careful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_051: Someone who used to mock me died. Strangely enough, I was sad.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_052: Someone stopped by earlier. They were already dead, so I killed them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_053: That thing you ate yesterday... no, I won't say it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_054: A zombie bit me once, but it had dentures. Lucky me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_055: I hear some people are trying to control the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_056: I can't name every president, but I know the next one. A zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_057: If we held an election now, the zombies would win.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_058: I think zombies still carry habits from when they were alive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_060: Maybe their goal isn't to eat us. Maybe it's to make more of themselves.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_061: There's no Superman. No Batman. So we have to fight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_062: I've thought \"this is it\" a hundred times. Still here.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_063: I've become prejudiced against zombies. Funny thing is, we're the minority now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_064: What's your favorite gun? ...That's a pretty old-school choice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_066: What's your favorite movie? ...Didn't expect that. You watch that kind of thing?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_067: What's your favorite comic? ...Yeah, that's a cool one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_068: Who taught you to shoot? Bruce Willis?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_069: That swing of yours is something else. Babe Ruth reincarnated, maybe?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_070: You're a good person. So I'll try to be one too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_071: I still haven't gotten used to the feeling of cutting a zombie with a knife.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_072: I like crushing zombie heads. Splat!
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_073: I'm fine with bringing in more people, but choose carefully.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_074: There were crows gathering in the woods. Means there's a body out there.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_075: Did you see a helicopter in the distance? No? ...Right.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_076: Someone said they saw a ten-foot zombie. Probably just saw wrong.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_077: I heard about a guy who walked straight through a horde. Then one day he tripped and died.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_078: Got any funny stories? ...Yeah, I heard that one already.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_079: Got any funny stories? ...Never heard that one. Don't care, though.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_080: Got any funny stories? ...Ha! No, wait. It wasn't that funny.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_081: There was a pebble in my shoe. It's always the little things that ruin your life.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_082: Sometimes there are smart ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_083: Sometimes there are fast ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_084: Aim for the head. Not mine. The zombie's.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_085: Head's worth 100 points, torso's 50, arms are 20. Sound fair?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_086: I heard survivors are gathering at the Gigamart. Zombies too, obviously.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_087: If you die, I die too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_088: Cats or dogs? ...Huh. So that's your answer.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_089: This place might be worse than medieval London.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_090: Sometimes I wonder if they're really dead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_091: Don't try to be a hero. You'll die.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_092: Maybe we're all standing on the edge between life and death. Us and them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_093: A .44's the way to go. Dirty Harry carried one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_094: Careful. This is the Wild West now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_095: Bang! Bang! Bang! How's my quick draw?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_096: Ever been to the West Coast? I haven't. Let's drive there someday.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_097: They say in Heaven, everybody talks about the ocean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_098: If it comes down to it, leave me behind. I won't leave you, though.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_099: Guess we're back to the frontier days. Want to plant an apple tree?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_100: I once shot at someone thinking they were a zombie. Good thing I missed.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_101: I'm tired... I can't remember the last time I wasn't.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_102: When I wake up, the first thing I do is check my hands.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_103: I can eat meat in the middle of that rotten stink now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_104: Choose the base location carefully. Please don't build it in the middle of a desert.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_105: The night is too quiet. Put on some club music or something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_106: I once knew a guy who put poisonous mushrooms in a stew. You be careful too.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_107: Do you know what bleach tastes like? I don't want to.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_108: Drive safely, all right? I'd hate to die in some stupid car crash.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_109: Someone said they saw a zombie climbing up the wall of a building. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_110: If you want to survive, make rules.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_111: Darkness, corners... those things are good at hiding their presence.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_112: Look around before throwing bombs. Don't blow up the house, okay?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_113: Burning zombies are dangerous. They keep walking while they're on fire.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_114: Someone said they saw a zombie dodge bullets. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_115: Someone said they saw a zombie with no head. You believe that?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_116: If you've got time, load some rounds into the magazines.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_117: Was that you banging on the wall last night?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_118: Shotguns are powerful, but they call in a lot of zombies. Don't use them at the wrong time.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_119: Magazines everywhere and no gun! Should we throw the magazines at them?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_120: Don't forget to turn off your flashlight.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_121: The sole of your boot is the strongest weapon.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_122: Splitting a zombie's head open in one hit is harder than it looks. There's a trick to it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_123: When you use a knife, don't carve them up. Drive it in with one clean thrust.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_124: If I turn into a zombie, then when that time comes... let's become zombies together, yeah?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_125: You're marking things on the map, right? Don't get lost.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_126: I hate the cold, and I hate the heat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_128: Keep your eyes on the road when you're driving, okay?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_129: I heard the Navy is taking survivors to some island.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_130: How many zombies have you killed so far? Me... I stopped counting.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_131: There was a Japanese guy fighting zombies with a katana. In the end, he died by seppuku.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_132: Listen, don't ever sneak up behind me. I might kill you by accident.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_133: I saw a rich guy get attacked and shove a wad of cash into a zombie's mouth before beating it to death.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_134: Even when civilization ends, some things never change.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_135: I saw a preacher trying to enlighten a zombie. The zombie listened for a while... then bit him.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_136: Only open canned food when you're ready to eat it. It'll spoil.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_137: Don't say it's just your imagination. If something feels off, check it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_138: One day, a bomb might fall and end everything... maybe that day will come.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_139: Collect books for me. I get bored when we're at the base.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_140: Persistent bastards. They follow you anywhere.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_141: Apparently they can't swim. They won't come into the river. Well, neither can we...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_142: Don't look for romance in a gun. This is real combat.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_143: At least we probably don't have to worry about World War III anymore.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_144: Which are you better with, knives or guns? ...I see. So that's why you're so bad.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_145: A chef is absolutely necessary. Food rules everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_146: There were so many things I wanted to do before all this... guess that's not happening now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_147: Put some seasoning in the food, will you? I hate tasteless meals.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_148: Sometimes I feel like pointing the barrel at myself instead of the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_149: I'm glad there aren't zombies running at us with bombs strapped to their bodies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_150: Building a home means being ready to fight for it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_151: There's something I always keep with me... wait, where did it go?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_152: I'm on cooking duty today. You don't have any picky eating habits, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_153: There's a zombie corpse lying around. Put it out on garbage day, will you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_154: If you find batteries, bring them back. I want to play my Game Boy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_155: Damn it, I just remembered I returned a video without rewinding it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_156: All right, watch up, down, front, back, left, and right. I'll have a smoke.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_157: Hey, you're not hiding cigarettes from me, are you?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_158: Whatever happens, don't panic. That 0.1 second can be what kills you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_159: I just saw an insanely beautiful woman... she was a zombie.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_160: That zombie I saw the other day was that famous... no? Oh. Never mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_161: In this world of slowpokes, I'm Carl Lewis.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_162: Under the bed, inside the closet, in the back seat... they can be anywhere, so stay sharp.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_163: Let me drive next time. My license got revoked, but still.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_164: That whiskey you hid under the bed? Sorry, I drank it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_165: I keep one bullet in my pocket... you know why, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_166: Don't run too much. You'll trip.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_167: You brought the travel itinerary, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_168: Where are we headed today? Disneyland?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_169: I keep dreaming that I wake up inside a coffin.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_170: They can see in the dark. Even if we can't see them, they can see us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_171: That blood on you... oh, it's just zombie blood.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_172: It's easy to blame someone. Easy, and that's all.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_173: Luckily, our group doesn't fight with each other. Lucky us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_174: Left or right... it's always a tough choice.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_175: They say meat tastes better when it's almost rotten, right?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_176: Once, I ate a huge hamburger and my jaw popped out. How do those things keep theirs attached?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_177: A doctor is absolutely necessary. A doctor who isn't a zombie, I mean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_178: Don't stick your muzzle out around a corner. Basic room clearing.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_180: Let's play chess sometime. The rules? We'll make them up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_181: Let's play poker sometime with the cards I made.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_182: Give me a better house, will you? Something like the White House.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_183: If you find a tank, tell me. I always wanted to ride one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_184: Don't get careless just because we have walls. Everything has a lifespan.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_185: Always stay cool. That's how you survive.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_186: Walk quietly. Like a cat, like a ninja...
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_187: Watch out for smells too, not just sounds... What? Your nose is stuffed and you can't smell anything?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_188: The people back at base bring in all kinds of items. Check on them once in a while.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_189: I won't fight if you're not nearby, so keep that in mind.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_190: Are you organizing the containers properly? I found a gun in the fridge.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_191: Are you organizing the containers properly? I found food in the armory.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_192: Could you please stop cooking with the same frying pan you used to beat a zombie?
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_193: There's a dessert on the shelf. A Desert Eagle, I mean.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_194: Put curtains on the windows, will you? I can't relax like this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_195: Please don't make this place a house made of nothing but containers.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_196: Please don't make this place a square box of a house.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_197: Stop leaving every damn thing on the floor.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_198: Don't go out on rainy days. It covers up every sign of the zombies.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_199: Dry your wet clothes properly. You'll catch a cold.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_NearPlayer_200: Sorry, I'm bad at locking up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_RecruitResponse: Thanks for having me. I'll follow your lead.
IGUI_NotAlone_Dialogue_WandererNearPlaye: I don't want to be alone. Please don't leave me behind.
Please, take me with you. I swear I'll be useful.
I can fight and scavenge. I won't be a burden.

IGUI_MiniHealth_UpdateNotes: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Mini Health Panel update 1.6.1 (B42 only) <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> - Fixed errors introduced in B42.13.0 (the multiplayer update). <LINE>   - - Fixed Lua errors occurring after being injured. <LINE> - - Fixed broken context menu. <LINE> - - Added item icons from the vanilla health panel context menu. <LINE> <LINE> This was not tested in multiplayer. This update has not been tested in multiplayer. Please report any errors you encounter in the Steam Workshop comments.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s001: You wake up with a hammering headache. After a long moment of observation, you realize the world you once knew has collapsed. Everything around has turned into soulless corpses staggering on the streets. Some of them, driven by hunger, are devouring chunks of fresh flesh... <LINE> <LINE> No matter what, you must survive first. <LINE> <LINE> The most essential thing for survival is water. Find some water to prepare for the survival journey ahead.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s002: The next important thing is food. Search for food around here.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s003: You remember your younger brother, the only one who ever cared about you, who is studying at Riverside high school. Even though your own survival is already a problem, you still want to go to that school to look for him. You whisper... brother, don't die.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s004: ...through the conversation, you learn that this woman is the vice principal. She says she remembers your brother. Five days before the outbreak, the city police and a group of strangers came to the school to collect blood samples from all students, then took your brother and four other students away. She doesn't know anything else. <LINE> <LINE> Perhaps you need to go to the Riverside Police Department for more information.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s005: ...you ask this police officer about the events 5 days before the outbreak. He says only the Police Chief knows the details; officers like him only follow orders. <LINE> <LINE> You ask about the Chief, and he says the Chief was not at the station when the apocalypse happened, then gives you the Police Chief's home address.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s006: From the Official Request for Coordination, you learn that the team that took your brother belongs to the Military Research Facility located in Hog Wallow Forest. <LINE> <LINE> To find your brother, you must go to the Military Research Facility.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s007: ...from the transfer document and the test report, you learn that your brother was taken to the Finnegan Research Group in Louisville.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s008: ...through the conversation, you learn that she is a research scientist at this facility. She states that no agency or test subject has come here during the time you mentioned. <LINE> <LINE> Go to the Louisville Metro Police Department to find more clues.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s009: ...through the conversation, you learn that he is a Lieutenant at this station. He knows about the transfer mission from the Military Research Facility, but the unit dispatched was ambushed by a group of strangers. The station sent reinforcements, but no updates ever came because the outbreak prevented them from reaching the site. He does not know the exact location of the ambush. <LINE> <LINE> Hint: You can search along the roads from the Military Research Facility to the Finnegan Research Group
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s010: You identify the ambush site by the uniforms on the bodies and the matching vehicle plates listed in the transfer document. You feel a growing sense of unease when you see that all of them are lying completely motionless.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s011: There is no one left alive around you. You feel a faint glimmer of hope when you realize your brother is not among the dead here. The only clue is a hastily written note in blood with three letters: MUL
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s042: ...Looking into the room, you are shocked to see your younger brother inside. You once thought you would never be able to see him again, so realizing that he is still alive and well, you can barely hold back your emotions.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s043: You pull your brother into a tight embrace and catch a glimpse of tears welling up in his eyes. Both of you are overwhelmed with joy at knowing your family has survived. <LINE> <LINE> When you ask about what happened before, your brother tells you that after arriving at the military camp, he was invited to join the nation's Super Soldier research project. Not long after, he was transferred to another facility that the scientists claimed was more suitable for him. <LINE> <LINE> However, during the transfer, the convoy was attacked by another group. Everyone was killed except him and one scientist. <LINE> <LINE> He was then taken to Raven Creek by that group, where scientists continued to study him. But the very next day, the entire building fell into chaos, zombies flooded the place, tearing apart every living being they encountered. <LINE> <LINE> More than a dozen armed personnel protected and escorted him out of the building and fled the city. Along the way, he witnessed things that filled him with overwhelming terror. <LINE> <LINE> By the time they reached a remote area, only four people were left alive, including him. After that, he was picked up by a helicopter and flown to an unknown location, before finally being brought here a few days ago. <LINE> <LINE> When the two doctors saw him, they questioned him and mentioned that someone was still searching for him. Hearing that, he realized that you were still alive. <LINE> <LINE> After finishing his story, your brother asks about you and the outside world. You tell him about your search for him and how terrifying the world beyond has become. Hearing this, he falls into deep thought. <LINE> <LINE> After taking a moment to steady your emotions, you suggest that the two of you go outside and talk with Dr. Venter.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s044: ...Dr. Venter explains that when he and his assistant arrived here, they never expected the test subject to match the description of your younger brother so closely. After speaking with him in person, he is almost certain that he has found the right person. <LINE> <LINE> Throughout this time, he has deliberately delayed the final stage of the experiment under the pretense of further examinations, waiting for you to arrive. <LINE> <LINE> When you ask about the experiment, Dr. Venter explains that this serum is designed to push human beings beyond their natural limits. It doesn't merely increase strength or endurance, but also enhances judgment, reflexes, and sensory perception… The serums he previously gave you only enhanced abilities within normal human limits, which is why they caused almost no side effects. <LINE> <LINE> This serum, however, is different. All previous test subjects were unable to withstand the biological changes, resulting in degeneration and death after about seven days. Your brother is considered a suitable candidate because the test data suggests his body may be able to adapt after the transformation. Still, this conclusion is based on data alone, and unexpected outcomes may occur during the actual process. <LINE> <LINE> If successful, your brother will gain abilities that surpass human limits, and it would also give Dr. Venter the opportunity to develop a more stable and safer version of the serum. After explaining everything clearly, he suggests that you and your brother talk privately to make a decision. <LINE> <LINE> When the conversation ends, your brother returns to his room, weighed down with conflicting thoughts. You understand that this decision can only be made by your brother himself, and that you need to talk to him to truly understand how he feels.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s045: ...You ask your brother what he thinks about all this. He doesn't answer right away, remaining silent for a long time before suddenly asking about his adoptive parents. You tell him that you don't know what has happened to them either. <LINE> <LINE> He grows quiet again, then asks whether the world could ever return to what it once was. Without waiting for an answer, he softly says that perhaps the world as it is now might actually be better. There would be no more bullies at school, no more street thugs blocking his way, and no more isolating, judgmental stares. <LINE> <LINE> You never imagined that your brother's past life had been filled with so much pain. You place a hand on his shoulder and tell him that from now on, you'll be by his side, and no one will ever bully him again. <LINE> <LINE> Lowering his head, your brother speaks of the bloodthirsty images of the zombies he has witnessed. All of it has only deepened his desire to become stronger, strong enough to bury his scars and survive the terrifying creatures outside. To him, this experiment is an opportunity. If it succeeds, he will no longer be a burden, and Dr. Venter may even be able to create a serum capable of strengthening you as well… <LINE> <LINE> In the end, your brother decides to accept the experiment. You choose to respect his decision.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s046: ...You tell Dr. Venter about your brother's decision. He lets out a sigh of relief, as if a heavy burden has finally been lifted from his shoulders, and informs you that the experiment will begin the following day.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s047: It's time for the experiment Dr. Venter scheduled. Go and speak with him.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s048: ...Dr. Venter tells you that everything is fully prepared, but if anything unexpected occurs, he will need your assistance. He points to a vial of liquid and explains that it is a serum he named the Super Human Serum, the culmination of many years of research. <LINE> <LINE> He explains to your brother that a few hours after the injection, he will experience intense pain throughout his entire body as his muscles and bones are stimulated to grow. The pain could even cause cardiac arrest and death, which is why Dr. Venter will have to administer a specially formulated painkiller on a regular basis. <LINE> <LINE> However, the maximum dosage can only prevent cardiac arrest, the remaining pain must be endured on his own. This process may last for about a day, so Dr. Venter stresses that he must not give up. <LINE> <LINE> After hearing this, your brother nods firmly. <LINE> <LINE> Confirm with Dr. Venter to begin the experiment.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s049: Dr. Venter and his assistant begin the Super Human Serum experiment. After a series of preparations, your brother's arms and legs are secured to the hospital bed. Moments later, Dr. Venter injects the Super Human Serum into his body. <LINE> <LINE> Wait a few hours to observe the reaction.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s050: You see the veins on your brother's body bulging, his limbs twitching, his teeth clenched tightly as if enduring unbearable pain. Ask Dr. Venter about his current condition.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s051: ...Dr. Venter says the serum has begun altering his body, and that the current state is a normal side effect. He will inject your brother with a special painkiller to help him endure the pain. He adds that the injection will be administered every six hours, and that after about a day, the pain should gradually subside. <LINE> <LINE> Continue waiting for the experiment to progress.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s052: Dr. Venter is looking for you. Go and talk to him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s053: ...Dr. Venter speaks to you in a state of deep anxiety. He tells you that your brother's pain has not subsided at all so far, whereas in previous experiments, this condition usually only lasted for about one day. <LINE> <LINE> Although he had prepared more painkillers than expected, the remaining supply is now running dangerously low. Therefore, he needs you to find a large amount of common Painkillers, or the medicinal herb Black Sage, so that he can continue producing the special pain-relief medicine. <LINE> <LINE> He hopes you can gather enough within three days. If not, he will be forced to intervene directly with your brother's body. This method may have long-term effects on your brother, and he is extremely reluctant to resort to it. <LINE> <LINE> Looking again at your brother's body, now massive and brimming with strength, you silently swear that you will not allow him to die before your eyes. <LINE> <LINE> Note: Black Sage can be found by foraging in the forest.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s054: Dr. Venter takes all of the materials and immediately begins producing more painkillers. You continue waiting for the experiment to progress.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s055: Dr. Venter has something to tell you. Go and speak with him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s056: ...Dr. Venter tells you that your brother's pain has been greatly reduced. Test results and other physical indicators also show positive signs. The transformation process is nearing its end, and the next stage will be adaptation. Based on previous experiments, this stage usually lasts about one day. <LINE> <LINE> Dr. Venter hopes that everything will proceed smoothly. You continue waiting for the experiment to progress.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s057: Dr. Venter is looking for you. Go and talk to him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s058: ...Dr. Venter tells you that although your brother's body has become powerful and physically imposing, he is completely unable to control it. His consciousness and thinking remain unaffected. All of his internal organs are healthy, some even surpass those of a normal human. He can still speak and feel every physical touch, yet he is entirely unable to move. He explains that this condition appeared after the serum-induced transformation process ended, and that he has not yet identified the cause. He says he will need several more days to continue his investigating.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s059: Dr. Venter has something to tell you. Go and speak with him in the laboratory.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s060: ...Dr. Venter tells you that he has not yet found a solution to this condition and is forced to wait for now. The research may take a considerable amount of time, but if he makes any discoveries, he will inform you immediately. <LINE> <LINE> You do not feel despair, because at least your brother is still alive, and this place is relatively safe. Aside from waiting for Dr. Venter to find a solution, perhaps you can also try to find other ways to help your brother. <LINE> <LINE> In addition, Dr. Venter informs you that the nutritional fluid supply is nearly depleted. Fortunately, your brother's digestive system is still functioning normally. During this period, someone will need to personally take care of his meals. <LINE> <LINE> Although Dr. Bassler can assist with this, her expertise lies in research and supporting Dr. Venter's work. As a result, only you can ensure the best possible condition for your brother. <LINE> <LINE> Note: Right-click on the NPC to display the care option.
IGUI_VLQ_1_Desc_q1s990: After enduring countless hardships, you finally found your brother. But surviving in this world has never been easy, especially when trying to endure it together. Your brother has passed away, leaving behind an aching longing and an unrelenting sense of self-blame within you.
IGUI_VLQ_1_HaloText1_q1s006: I should look for clues in these documents if no one else survived
IGUI_VLQ_1_HaloText1_q1s007: It looks like someone's on the roof

IGUI_VLQ_1_NotePage1_1_q1s005: ...the main content is that the Facility Commander at the Military Research Facility sent this to the City Police Chief. The document requests the police force to immediately coordinate with the team being deployed. The time is 5 days before the outbreak.
IGUI_VLQ_1_NotePage1_1_q1s006: ...inside is your brother's name, room B14-15, registered 5 days before the outbreak.
IGUI_VLQ_1_NotePage2_1_q1s006: ...inside is an introduction to the current facility. This is a combined research and military facility, also known as the National Microbiology and Biotechnology Research Facility No. 22, abbreviated as NMB Research Facility No. 22. It specializes in researching and applying microbiology to enhance human physical capabilities.
IGUI_VLQ_1_NotePage3_1_q1s006: ...inside is a report on research into enhancing human strength and physical fitness, currently in the human testing phase.
IGUI_VLQ_1_NotePage4_1_q1s006: ...inside, your brother's name is mentioned, labeled as 'test subject No. 2508'. <LINE> The conclusion states that subject No. 2508 is a special case, suitable for multiple research programs including: Super Soldier No. 1, No. 2, and No. 4.

IGUI_VLQ_2_Desc_q1s014: ...through the conversation, you learn that she is Dr. Bassler, Dr. Venter's assistant. IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s001: You hear faint noises coming from the barricaded house ahead of you. You hesitate, unsure whether you should investigate further.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s002: You see two people inside the room: a middle-aged man watching you with clear suspicion, and a woman lying on the bed with her leg braced in a splint, seemingly injured, looking at you with exhausted eyes. <LINE> <LINE> The man asks whether you are military personnel sent to provide assistance. You shake your head, act friendly, and explain that you just happened to pass by. <LINE> <LINE> Seeing that you mean no harm, the man lowers his guard somewhat. He sits down, takes the hand of the woman lying on the bed, and says that there is nothing left here; if you have no further business, he hopes you will leave. <LINE> <LINE> After saying that, he silently wipes the sweat from the woman's face, clearly not wishing to continue the conversation.
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s003: ...The man seems grateful and noticeably friendlier. He introduces himself as Bob, and the woman beside him as Kate, his wife. <LINE> <LINE> Bob goes on to explain their current situation. Kate has a broken leg and cannot move. She has also been coughing and running a fever since yesterday; Bob assumes it is just a common flu. However, there is no proper medicine left in the house. All of their food so far has been gathered by Bob, who risks going outside to find it. Bob has repeatedly called for help over the radio, but no one has come. He worries about Kate and cannot go too far, and there is nothing left in the surrounding area. Since Kate started coughing and running a fever, he has fallen into deeper despair, shouting into the radio and waiting hopelessly for rescue. <LINE> <LINE> After finishing his story, Bob grips the food you gave him more tightly; with it, his wife may survive for a few more days. <LINE> <LINE> After hearing Bob and Kate's situation, you hesitate, unsure whether you should help them. <LINE> <LINE> Talk to Bob if you decide to help them..
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s004: ...You take the initiative and offer to help the couple. Bob and Kate are deeply grateful; recently, they have barely seen any kindness from others. All they have witnessed along the way has been rejection, looting, and the coldness of human hearts. <LINE> <LINE> Bob grips your hand tightly, thanking you even though you have not done anything yet. After calming his emotions, Bob asks you to help him find some medical supplies. He says Kate urgently needs them. <LINE> <LINE> Required supplies: 1x Paracetamol, 6x Antibiotics, 1x Cold Pack
IGUI_VLQ_3_Desc_q3s005: ...Bob takes the medicine you give him, clearly moved. With these supplies, he believes his wife will recover soon. <LINE> <LINE> After a while, Bob hesitantly speaks up again, hoping you can help him one more time by finding suitable food for Kate. He needs rice to cook porridge, along with sugar and salt to help replenish electrolytes. IGUI_Instruments_Band: Band Play: Once all players are ready, have one member of your group hold down the 'X' key for a few seconds to start the song.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body: Group performances are a unique and engaging mechanic that lets players collaborate musically in-game. By forming a band with friends, you can play coordinated songs using different instruments to create a dynamic and immersive experience. Whether you're a vocalist or an instrumentalist, group performances add a layer of fun and creativity to the game, perfect for adding some harmony to the chaos of the apocalypse.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body2: <H1> Getting Started <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Instruments_Band_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT> 1. Level Up Your Music Skill <LINE><TEXT> To participate in group performances, you'll need at least Music Level 4, but it's worth leveling up further. Higher levels unlock more band songs, expanding your repertoire and improving your overall performance. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 2. Develop Instrument Affinity <LINE><TEXT> Each instrument requires a certain level of familiarity, gained by learning songs for that instrument. Aim for about 20 learned songs to unlock the Group Perform option. This may sound like a lot, but at higher Music Levels, it's an easy to reach threshold. <LINE> Exception: Singing doesn't require instrument affinity, only Music Skill progression. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 3. Choose Your Role <LINE><TEXT> Each part of a band performance is tied to a specific instrument or the microphone (for vocals). While a full band with multiple instruments offers the most depth, you can perform with as few as two players. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 4. Starting the Performance <LINE><TEXT> First enter the 'Waiting Phase' by selecting the song you want to play. When in this phase, characters will just hold their instruments as if about to play, thus giving other players time to prepare. Once everyone is in the waiting phase, one player must hold the X key for a few seconds to begin the song (it's recommended that only one player hold the key down). The performance will then start, with each player contributing their selected part. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 5. Fail-Proof Fun <LINE><TEXT> Group performances are designed to be fun and frustration-free. You can't fail a song due to low skill, so even beginners can join in without worry. However, keep in mind that panic (if your character isn’t desensitized) can still disrupt the performance.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body3: <H1> Tips for Success <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Instruments_Band_03.png><LINE><LINE><H2><LEFT> - Build your repertoire early to have a wide selection of songs for group play. <LINE><LINE> - Coordinate with friends to assign roles and instruments before starting a session. <LINE><LINE> - Ensure your group is in a safe environment to avoid panic or interruptions during performances.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body4: <H2> Group performances bring a cooperative and lighthearted touch to the game, letting you and your friends create memorable moments while surviving the apocalypse!
IGUI_InvWorkbench_Completed_Gnome: Production completed? <LINE><TEXT> Huh... what is this? You have no recollection of how or why you've made this thing. Did you even create it or did it will itself into existence?
IGUI_InvWorkbench_Completed_Invention: New creation! <LINE><TEXT> Open the workbench menu to retrieve it.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_Completed_Production: Production completed! <LINE><TEXT> Open the workbench menu to get your creation.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Bummed: In addition, critical failures will always leave you feeling bummed for a while. It's inevitable after such a disaster.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Explosion: Ouch ouch ouch! Some parts exploded and almost took you with them! At least the workbench and some of your work seems to be intact, you think? Unfortunately the same can't be said for your eyebrows. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project progress was greatly reduced and some materials were lost and will need to be replaced, the explosion might have also caused some injuries.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Reset: Enough! None of this is working! You kept arriving at roadblock after roadblock during the development of this project. You lost count of how many issues critical flaws you've ignored, but as grim as it looks there might still be a chance to save this project, albeit with a complete reset of the current phase. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project phase duration was reset.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Ruined: Enough! None of this is working! You kept arriving at roadblock after roadblock during the development of this project. You lost count of how many issues and critical flaws you've ignored and now it feels like trying to save a sinking ship with cheap duct tape. This piece of junk can't be saved and it's best to just scrap whatever's left and forget this humiliating mistake. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project was destroyed beyond repair.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Void: There are mental blocks and then there's this... There's something very wrong with you, it feels like your mind is floating in an endless void of pure nothingness. Try as you might you can't get out of this lull and you fear it might take a day or two fully recover. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Mental blocks prevent you from working and this time it will take much longer than usual to wear off.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Bummed: For one reason or another, this issue was specially upsetting and now you just don't feel like continuing this project for a while.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Material: You're not sure how it happened, but due to negligence or incompetence some materials got too damaged to be usable and will need to be replaced. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Some materials were lost.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Progress: This just isn't working... You're not exactly sure where the issue is, but you have hit too many roadblocks with your current design to finally admit you need to take a few steps back and try another approach. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project progress was reduced slightly.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Skill: Everything seems to be going fine with this project, but you can't shake the feeling that there's something wrong. Perhaps... with you? <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> It seems some inventing experience was lost.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Study: Despite your efforts, ideas just didn't seem to want to flow to you and the harder you tried the worse the mental block got. You probably need a few hours to cool down. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Mental blocks prevent you from working, but wears off after a few hours.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_FocusGood: Everything became clear. The usual doubts, distractions and bad surprises are all lining up into useful ideas. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> No more bad events can happen for the rest of the project.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_InstaFinish: That's it! Somehow everything finally came together much sooner than you expected. The last problems were solved in one inspired burst of unquestionable brilliance. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> The current phase was completed instantly.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_ProgressBig: A major hurdle gave way all at once. What looked like a messy pile of compromises suddenly revealed itself as a workable design, which is either genius or extremely lucky. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Project progress was greatly increased.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_SkillBig: You've just experienced a rare moment where the difference between foolish tinkering and smart inventing became beautifully obvious. Unfortunately, now you know exactly how much of your previous work was foolish tinkering. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> A large amount of inventing experience was gained.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Focus: For once, everything just seems to click. All distractions fade into the background as your sole focus is your project. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> No more events can happen in this phase, good or bad.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_GoodMood: This is going better than expected! For once the workbench doesn't feel like a personalized torture device with drawers. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> This small streak of success left you in a better mood.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Lucky: You're not entirely sure why, but luck seems to be on your side for now. Best not to question it too much. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> The next bad event that occurs in this phase will be nullified.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Lucky_trigge: You flinch as a cold feeling permeates your body and then vanishes just as quickly. Somehow you're certain that you just avoided disaster. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> A bad event was nullified by sheer luck.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Progress: A few loose ideas finally snapped into place. The project still has some way to go, but one annoying problem solved itself much more cleanly than expected. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Project progress was increased slightly.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Skill: You stumbled into a small but useful realization while working on this project. It may not be groundbreaking, but it taught you something practical about the inventing process. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Some inventing experience was gained.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_SkillBoost: Suddenly learning new things has become much easier as you feel your mind more sharp and capable than before. You should probably take advantage of this boon. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Double inventing experience gain until you stop working.
